sections.description:
RULES OF PROCEDURE AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS IN THE SENATE, 1988
RULES OF
PROCEDURE AND CONDUCT OF BUSINESS IN THE SENATE, 1988
(Amendment of R.146)
[Gazette of
Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part II, 7th February, 2006]
S.R.O. 90(I)/2006, dated 6-2-2006.---The following
amendments made by the Senate in rule 146 of the Rules of Procedure and Conduct
of Business in the Senate, 1988 on the 6th February, 2006, under rule 242 of
these rules, are published for general information:-‑
"in
the Rules of Procedure and Conduct of Business in the Senate, 1988, in rule
146,-‑
(i) in
sub-rule (1),-‑
(a) after
the word "Senate", occurring for the first time, the words "or
the Chairman" be inserted; and
(b) after
the word "Senate", occurring for the second time, the words and
commas "or the Chairman, as the case may be," be inserted.
(ii) after
sub-rule (3), the following new sub-rule (4) be added, namely:
"(4) A Committee may
examine suo motu the expenditures, administration, delegated legislation, the
public petitions and policies of the Ministry concerned and its
attached corporation and public bodies and may call for views of the Ministry.
After examining the views of the Ministry, the Committee shall make a report to
the Senate, which may make such recommendations thereon as it may deem
fit."
